versions.changelog:
Initial release of the find-docs skill for authoritative, up-to-date technical documentation retrieval.

- Enables searching and retrieving docs, code examples, API references, and configuration details for any developer technology via Context7 CLI.
- Requires a two-step workflow: resolve library name to ID, then query documentation using that ID.
- Emphasizes privacy (no sensitive info in queries) and accuracy (prefer docs over model knowledge).
- Includes error handling instructions for quota issues and best practices for forming effective queries.
- Provides clear guidance for using version-specific library IDs and handling ambiguous requests.
